title: Elihu Describes God's Correction and Greatness
summary_text: Elihu says God watches the righteous and uses pain to show people their transgression and turn them from iniquity. He says the wicked die, while those who obey God prosper. He ends with God's rain, clouds, lightning, and thunder, through which He judges nations and gives food.

title: Elihu Calls Job to Consider God's Wonders
summary_text: Elihu trembles as he describes God's thunderous voice and lightning spreading across the sky. God directs snow, rain, cold, and clouds, carrying out His purposes in punishment and loving devotion. Elihu asks Job whether he understands these wonders or could spread out the sky himself. He ends by saying that the Almighty is beyond human reach, mighty and great in righteousness, and does not oppress or show favoritism to the wise.

title: The LORD Questions Job About His Creation

title: Job Repents and the LORD Restores Him
summary_text: Job admits that he spoke beyond what he knew and expresses repentance in dust and ashes.
